title: zazzle-llm use cases
description: Asking a local open model from the shell, having zazzle ask it for an agent, and choosing which one answers. The steps before zazzle-llm starts (the invoker's exec of `zazzled llm`, and zazzled downloading zazzle-llm on first use) are in the invoker's and zazzled's views.

entities.name: Ask a local model
entities.description: A coding agent asks an open model on the developer's machine for a second opinion, a review or a summary, without an API key and without the text leaving the machine.
entities.goal: Get a local model's answer to a prompt on standard output.
preconditions: zazzle-llm is beside zazzled or can be downloaded for this release (see the zazzled views).
The chosen model is downloaded, or huggingface.co is reachable and there is room for it.
postconditions: The answer was written to standard output, ending with a newline; thinking went nowhere, or to standard error with --show-thinking.
The exit status is 0 for a full answer and 3 when the token limit cut it short.
A model that was missing is installed in the model store, verified.

flow.action: Runs `zazzle-llm prompt [--model NAME] [--effort low|medium|high] [--system TEXT] [--max-tokens N] [--show-thinking] TEXT..`, with `-` (or no TEXT) for piped standard input.
Picks the model (--model, else the saved default, else qwen3.5-4b), by exact name or unique prefix, and the effort (--effort, else the saved one, else medium).
Joins the words with spaces, putting standard input where a word is `-`, or reads only standard input when there are no words.

When the model is not installed, says so on standard error and downloads it from huggingface.co at the pinned commit, with progress when standard error is a terminal, resuming a partial download and installing it only when size and SHA-256 match.

Loads the model, renders its chat template with the messages and the effort, decodes the prompt and samples up to the token limit (4096, 8192 or 32768 by effort, or --max-tokens), held to --grammar when given and at --temp (default 0.7; 0 is greedy).
Splits each piece of text into answer and thinking, writes the answer to standard output as it comes, and the thinking to standard error only with --show-thinking; exits 0.

alternatives.condition: The model name matches no model or several, or the effort is not low, medium or high.
alternatives.outcome: `error: no model 'NAME'; known: ..`, `error: 'NAME' could be ..` or `error: no effort ..` on standard error, exit 2.

alternatives.condition: The prompt is empty or only blank.
alternatives.outcome: `error: nothing to ask: give TEXT, or pipe it in`, exit 2, before any download.

alternatives.condition: The download fails, or the file's size or SHA-256 differs from the catalogue's.
alternatives.outcome: The error on standard error, exit 2; a mismatching partial file is deleted, an interrupted one is kept for the next try.

alternatives.condition: --no-download is given and the model is not installed.
alternatives.outcome: `error: NAME is not downloaded (SIZE): run `zazzle agent llm --model NAME` first` on standard error, exit 4; nothing is downloaded.

alternatives.condition: The model cannot be loaded, has no chat template, its template fails, or the prompt is as long as the model's training context or longer.
alternatives.outcome: The error on standard error, exit 2.

alternatives.condition: Generation stopped at the token limit or the context's end.
alternatives.outcome: `[stopped after N tokens, the answer is cut short ..]` (or `still thinking, no answer yet`) on standard error, exit 3.

entities.name: Answer for zazzle's agent features
entities.description: zazzled hands an agent's work to the local model: post-processing a command's output (`--llm`), choosing the rule sections a task needs (`brief`) or answering `prompt`, by running zazzle-llm as a child that never downloads a model.
entities.goal: Read the local model's short answer instead of a whole output or every rule file.
preconditions: The developer has downloaded a model (`zazzle agent llm --model NAME`).
zazzled finds zazzle-llm through ZAZZLE_LLM, beside itself or in the tool store.
postconditions: zazzled has the answer from standard output and the exit code: 0 full, 3 cut short; nothing was downloaded.

flow.action: Runs a zazzle command with `--llm INSTRUCTION`, `zazzle brief INTENT` or `zazzle prompt TEXT` (or their MCP tools).

Runs `zazzle-llm prompt --no-download` with the flags of the feature (low effort, --temp 0 and a result-only --system for --llm; also --grammar for brief), the instruction, and `-` with the input on standard input, one call at a time.
Picks the default model and checks it is installed instead of downloading it.
Generates under the grammar, when given, with the greedy sampler at temperature 0, and writes the answer to standard output.
Reads the answer and exit code and gives the agent the answer (marked as post-processed for --llm, or as chosen sections for brief).

alternatives.outcome: zazzle-llm exits 4 with the command to download it; zazzled reports `local model: NAME is not downloaded ..` as the error.

alternatives.condition: The input is over 400,000 bytes, zazzle-llm cannot be started, or it runs past ZAZZLE_LLM_TIMEOUT.
alternatives.outcome: zazzled refuses or kills it and reports the reason as the error.

entities.name: Choose the default model and effort
entities.description: The developer looks at the catalogue and picks the model and effort `prompt` uses when none is named, or deletes a model they no longer want.
entities.goal: Have the model and effort they want ready on their machine as the default.
preconditions: zazzle is installed with a zazzled that can run zazzle-llm.
postconditions: The defaults file names the chosen model and effort, and the model is installed.

flow.action: Runs `zazzle agent llm` and reads the catalogue: each model's size, whether it is downloaded, what it is for and the Mac it fits, with the default marked.
Downloads the model unless it is installed, then writes the model and effort to the defaults file and prints them.

alternatives.outcome: The effort is saved and the default model kept, without a download.
The model's file and any partial download are deleted: `removed NAME`, or `NAME was not downloaded`.

alternatives.condition: The name or effort is unknown, or the download fails.
alternatives.outcome: The error on standard error, exit 2; the defaults are not changed.
